name: Dinar Detergent Cake
tagline: With lemon powder, for extra brightness.
description: Dinar Detergent Cake is a detergent bar made with lemon powder. It brings extra brightness to everyday laundry and comes in a 200 g pack.

variants.label: 200 g
variants.imageAlt: Dinar Detergent Cake 200 g pack with lemon powder

howToUse.hi: कपड़ों को पानी में भिगो लें।

howToUse.en: Rub the cake on stains and dirty areas.
howToUse.hi: दाग़ वाली जगह पर केक रगड़ें।

howToUse.en: Scrub well and rinse in clean water.
howToUse.hi: अच्छी तरह मलकर साफ़ पानी से धो लें।
